name: ParametricNoise Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion
plain: Uses the incoming noise to seed a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation and returns the V field as the new noise. The noise is blurred by repeated heat-equation steps, soft-thresholded so about seed_density of the plane nucleates, then integrated with an explicit 5-point periodic Laplacian; dt is capped at the stability bound and both fields are clamped to [0,1] each step. Steps 0, or a field that dies out, falls back to the incoming noise. The result is gaussianized by rank and renormalized.
math:
Symbols: U,V fields; F feed; k kill; D_u, D_v diffusion; Δ periodic 5-point Laplacian.
seed = N(blur(x)); m = sigmoid(8(seed − Φ⁻¹(1−density))); U=1−0.5m; V=strength·m.
U += dt(D_uΔU − UV² + F(1−U)); V += dt(D_vΔV + UV² − (F+k)V); clamp [0,1]; dt ≤ 1/(4·max(D_u,D_v)).
out = N(gaussianize(V)).

props.params: preset spots|stripes|labyrinth|holes|custom, steps 120 (max 500), feed 0.035, kill 0.065, du 0.16, dv 0.08, dt 1.0, seed_density 0.25, seed_blur 24, seed_strength 0.4
